title: 汇丰Joey Chu：日元避险买盘未现，欧元为何成美元走弱受益者？
speaker: Joey Chu

segments.en: So I think that is the key difference. Okay. Dollar yen is interesting, right?
segments.zh: 所以我认为这是关键区别。美元兑日元很有意思，对吧？

segments.en: I mean, we're seeing a bit of a haven bid right now.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，我们现在看到了一些避险买盘。

segments.en: Do you think that that can last against all the volatility that we're seeing when it comes to the tech trade right now?
segments.zh: 你认为在当前科技板块交易的所有波动中，这种情况能持续吗？

segments.en: I think much depends on also the BOJ because it is a huge event coming out in just a couple of hours.
segments.zh: 我认为很大程度上也取决于日本央行，因为几小时后将有一个重大事件。

segments.en: So, you know, compared to say last week, I think, you know, the dollar yen did do pretty well earlier than we last week.
segments.zh: 所以，与上周相比，我认为美元兑日元上周早些时候表现相当不错。

segments.en: But this time around today, not so clear, the safe haven bid, instead, the beneficiary of the dollar weakness overnight was the euro.
segments.zh: 但今天这个时候，情况不太明朗，避险买盘没有出现，相反，隔夜美元走弱的受益者是欧元。

segments.en: So this time around, I think, for a yen market is still waiting to see what's going on with BOJ, right?
segments.zh: 所以这一次，我认为日元市场仍在等待日本央行的动向，对吧？

segments.en: So there are a few things that we are thinking about. First of all, the number of these cents in the rate-hold decision because the rate-hold is widely expected.
segments.zh: 所以我们正在考虑几件事。首先，利率维持决定中的分歧数量，因为维持利率是广泛预期的。

segments.en: By the number of these cents, right? It's going to be one or two or maybe even three, right?
segments.zh: 分歧数量，对吧？可能是一个、两个甚至三个，对吧？

segments.en: And then the second thing is also the outlook report.
segments.zh: 然后第二件事是展望报告。

segments.en: What are you going to think about inflation for next year, especially when there's going to be all this consumption tax cuts next year?
segments.zh: 明年通胀你怎么看，尤其是明年会有这么多消费税削减？

segments.en: And then the third thing is obviously the presser by Governor Hueda.
segments.zh: 第三件事显然是Hueda行长的新闻发布会。

segments.en: So there are so many things that to consider.
segments.zh: 所以有太多事情需要考虑。

segments.en: So I think, you know, the safe haven bid, if it does come in for the yen, is not going to be until after all these events are over.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，日元的避险买盘如果真出现，也要等所有这些事件结束后。
